set.body: Build package-free reference laws for Diedrichsen et al. Eqs. 10 and 13. Verify the complete D-by-D covariance, not only diagonals; cover signal-dependent and signal-independent terms and explicitly test the sample-SD naive factor sqrt(M+1) versus the distinct sqrt(M-1) comparison. Record citation and scaling conventions.
set.title: Prove full Eq. 13 oracle and all-pairs estimator equivalence
